verdict.rationale: Apify's platform is built around Actors that run scraping/automation jobs at scale, with API, CLI, scheduling, MCP server for AI agents, and dataset export — all supporting bulk, programmatic operations across many items (e.g., pages, records) at once. Docs and probes confirm API/CLI/MCP access enabling AI-native bulk automation, though evidence is vendor-sourced with limited independent verification of scale.
